name: service-opentelemetry
title: OpenTelemetry
description: Server and browser OpenTelemetry for errors, traces, metrics, logs, and named events.
docs:
## Setup

Server/browser telemetry infrastructure for errors, traces, metrics, logs and named events. [Events](./service-events) adds consent UI, page tracking and optional SQL audit history.

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add @krak-stack/service-opentelemetry
```

### Server

```dotenv
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=my-app-api
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318
OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp
OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp
OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp
```

```ts
import { Layer } from 'effect';
import { Otlp } from '@/services/opentelemetry';
import { HttpApiOtlp } from '@/services/opentelemetry/api';

const server = HttpApiOtlp.layer.pipe(Layer.provideMerge(Otlp.layer));
```

`Otlp.layer` owns server exporters and works without HTTP in workers/CLIs. `HttpApiOtlp.layer` adds browser ingestion endpoints; it does not construct its own Otlp foundation. Provide `Events.ingestionLayer` for application-event enrichment/persistence as shown in [Events setup](./service-events#setup).

### Browser

Mount in your browser runtime, not during SSR:

```ts
import { BrowserOtlp } from '@/services/opentelemetry/browser';

const telemetry = BrowserOtlp.layer({ serviceName: 'my-app-web' });
```

| Browser option | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `serviceName` | Required |
| `traces` | `{}`; automatic browser errors included; false disables both |
| `events` | `{}`; false disables all event export |
| `logs`, `metrics` | false; enable independently with `{}` |
| `baseUrl` | `/api/otel` |
| `attributes`, `serviceVersion`, `headers` | Optional resource/transport metadata |

BrowserOtlp creates no automatic page tracking or visitor/session identity. Automatic errors use generic messages and sanitized source locations. Do not attach sensitive identity/resource annotations to essential diagnostics.

### Add analytics and consent

```tsx
import { Layer } from 'effect';
import { BrowserEvents } from '@/services/events/browser';
import { TrackingNotice } from '@/services/events/client/tracking-notice';
import { BrowserWebVitals } from '@/services/opentelemetry/web-vitals';

const browser = Layer.mergeAll(
  BrowserEvents.layer(),
  BrowserWebVitals.layer(),
).pipe(Layer.provideMerge(telemetry));

// Mount once in a persistent footer. English/French defaults are included.
<TrackingNotice privacyHref="/privacy-policy" />
```

BrowserEvents and Web Vitals require shared acceptance by default and honor DNT/GPC. Web Vitals requires consent before navigation begins and does not resume within a document after withdrawal. Essential automatic error reporting is independent of that choice. Generic events, custom spans, metrics/logs and third-party scripts are application-owned; do not use them to bypass preferences. See [tracking consent](./service-events#tracking-consent) for the policy and overrides.

## Named events

Run these Effects inside the appropriate runtime:

```ts
yield* Otlp.event('order.completed', { total: 42 });
yield* BrowserOtlp.event('diagnostic.ready', { component: 'editor' });
```

Events are INFO OTLP logs; they do not create spans or SQL history. Invalid inputs fail schema validation.

| Event option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `userId`, `anonymousId`, `sessionId` | Explicit identity attributes; never proof of authentication |
| `messageId` | Correlation ID, not guaranteed collector deduplication |
| `context` | Flat attributes |
| `timestamp` | Effect DateTime.Utc occurrence time |

Attribute precedence: context, properties, explicit identity options, scoped log annotations. Values support strings, finite numbers, booleans and homogeneous arrays. Keep sensitive data out of telemetry.

## Web Vitals

The optional BrowserWebVitals layer reports document-level LCP, INP, CLS, FCP and TTFB through the shared BrowserOtlp exporter. No SQL is required; these are not SPA navigation timings.

If using Web Vitals without Events UI, you must still integrate the shared consent preference or explicitly assess a deployment override:

```ts
const browser = BrowserWebVitals.layer({
  requireConsent: false,
  respectDoNotTrack: true,
}).pipe(Layer.provideMerge(telemetry));
```

This override is not a claim of legal exemption. With `requireConsent: true`, shared consent honors DNT/GPC even if `respectDoNotTrack` is false.

Events use name `browser.web_vital`, scope `krakstack.events` and these attributes:

| Attribute suffix under `browser.web_vital.*` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `name`, `id` | Metric name and instance ID |
| `value`, `delta` | Cumulative value and change since the previous report |
| `rating` | good / needs-improvement / poor |
| `navigation_type` | Library navigation type |

Values are milliseconds except unitless CLS. Use the latest cumulative value or sum deduplicated deltas, not cumulative values. Unsupported metrics may be absent. Closing the layer releases its subscriber; library observers are document-scoped. No URLs, DOM attribution, performance entries or analytics identity are exported automatically.

## Transport

```ts
const telemetry = BrowserOtlp.layer({
  serviceName: 'my-app-web',
  events: { exportInterval: '5 seconds', maxBatchSize: 20 },
});
```

Default event batching is 30 seconds / 100 records. `shutdownTimeout` is also configurable. Page-hidden/shutdown flushing is best effort and uses browser keepalive. Consent is checked before batch serialization; already-started exports and their retries are not cancelled by withdrawal.

| Concern | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Browser endpoints | `/api/otel/v1/{traces,metrics,logs}` |
| Server overrides | `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_{LOGS,METRICS,TRACES}_{ENDPOINT,HEADERS}` |
| `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true` | Disables server export, not browser collection |
| Storage/credentials | Collector-owned; credentials remain server-side |

Apply edge limits, collector retention and access controls. Package imports: `@krak-stack/registry/opentelemetry`, `/opentelemetry/api`, `/opentelemetry/browser` and `/opentelemetry/web-vitals`.
